card.name: Inside radiopharmaceutical element names
card.fires_on: The final piece of radioactive-agent names, mostly the "ium" ending of Technetium before Tc 99m, also Tc itself, indium, and radiolabeled.

modes.label: Technetium ending
modes.description: The "ium" completing Technetium right before Tc 99m and a kit or agent name.

modes.label: Other radiolabel names
modes.description: Endings of indium or radiolabeled, or the symbol Tc, in nuclear imaging text.

card.writes: It slightly favors words like actual and rolling, with no clear link to the radiopharmaceutical context.
card.plain: It lights up when a radioactive tracer name such as technetium is being finished, just before the isotope label.
